description: Round-trip a portlet collection through its own XML representation by rendering it via the collection's serialization entry point and rebuilding a fresh collection via the collection builder's parse entry point, then report the rebuilt collection as a deterministic dump giving the portlet count and, per portlet in order, its identifier, class, parameter count, and each parameter as a sorted name/value line. These cases exercise boundary inputs: an empty collection, a record with no initialization parameters, several records, and parameter values containing characters with XML significance.

cases.expected_output:
portlets=2
[0] id=alpha
[0] class=com.dotcms.Alpha
[0] init_count=1
[0] init.a=1
[1] id=beta
[1] class=com.dotcms.Beta
[1] init_count=2
[1] init.b=2
[1] init.c=3

portlets=1
[0] id=markup
[0] class=com.dotcms.Markup
[0] init_count=1
[0] init.expr=a < b & c > d
